subject: Errror: there is no package called 'codetools'

messages.author: 7343ed747ee19c08
messages.subject: Errror: there is no package called 'codetools'
parts:
I'm trying to publish my ioslides_presentation to shyniapps.io but getting an error: error there is no package called 'codetools'. 

And I dont use it in my project. The only package I use is ggplot2. 

What could be the potential problem?

Thank, 

Yevgen.

Thank, 

Yevgen.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Errror: there is no package called 'codetools'
parts:
That is correct. When you use caching in knitr, you will need the
codetools package. That said, I'm a little surprised that it was not
installed automatically, since it is a recommended package that should
normally be included in base R. Anway, adding library(codetools)
should solve the problem. Or if (FALSE) library(codetools) if you
don't want to "pollute" your workspace.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Errror: there is no package called 'codetools'
parts:
Dear Yihui and Joshua,

after adding 

library(codetools)

in setup section
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(codetools)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

it works. Thank you very much for your help.

Sincerely, 
Yevgen.
